*A starts a READ ONLY report at REPEATABLE READ and pauses before committing.*

```transcript
A> BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY;
BEGIN

A> SELECT count(*)::int AS orders FROM orders;
 orders 
--------
      2 
(1 row)
```

*Detector 1 — the oldest open transaction, and how long it's been open:*

```transcript
M> SELECT application_name, state, now() - xact_start > interval '1 second' AS older_than_1s
   FROM pg_stat_activity
   WHERE xact_start IS NOT NULL AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()
   ORDER BY xact_start LIMIT 1;
 application_name |        state        | older_than_1s 
------------------+---------------------+---------------
 A                | idle in transaction | t             
(1 row)
```

*Detector 2 — sessions holding a transaction open while doing nothing:*

```transcript
M> SELECT application_name
   FROM pg_stat_activity
   WHERE state = 'idle in transaction' AND now() - state_change > interval '1 second'
   ORDER BY application_name;
 application_name 
------------------
 A                
(1 row)
```

*Detector 3: A retains a snapshot horizon (backend_xmin), without an assigned top-level xid. An xid is not a count of writes; this query does not execute VACUUM or measure storage reclamation.*

```transcript
M> SELECT application_name, backend_xid IS NOT NULL AS has_xid,
          backend_xmin IS NOT NULL AS retains_snapshot
   FROM pg_stat_activity
   WHERE backend_xmin IS NOT NULL AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()
   ORDER BY application_name;
 application_name | has_xid | retains_snapshot 
------------------+---------+------------------
 A                | f       | t                
(1 row)

A> COMMIT;
COMMIT
```
